content: Read a thousand books, and you remain a scholar. Read two and a half letters of love (*Prem*), and you become truly wise.
author: Kabir
explanation: Intellectual accumulation of scriptures and philosophies puffs up the ego, but a single drop of unselfish, heartfelt love transforms human character into genuine wisdom.
practicalInsight: Set aside intellectual debate today. Treat every person you interact with through the lens of warm, compassionate kindness.
reflectionPrompt: Am I using intellectual knowledge to keep people at a distance instead of loving them openly?
